articles.title: US family buys 120-year-old abandoned railroad car for 3000 dollars. Once home to 20 feral cats, the accommodation now rents for 350 dollars per night
articles.description: A forgotten 1906 train car was transformed into a unique Airbnb. The US family purchased the dilapidated carriage for three thousand dollars. They spent five months renovating the historic structure into a luxury rental. The former mail compartment became a comfortable bedroom and a spacious bathroom. This restored railway carriage now commands over three hundred fifty dollars nightly.
